title: JSON Round-Trip
prompt: Implement save_records(records, path) writing a JSON list (ensure_ascii=False) and load_records(path) reading it back. Both use UTF-8 explicitly.

tests.name: round-trips unicode safely
tests.code:
from pathlib import Path
import tempfile, os
records = [{'name': 'Minh', 'note': 'xin chào'}]
p = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp()) / 'rec.json'
save_records(records, p)
assert load_records(p) == records

tests.name: file content is valid JSON
tests.code:
from pathlib import Path
import tempfile, json
p = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp()) / 'r.json'
save_records([{'a': 1}], p)
assert json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')) == [{'a': 1}]
tests.hint: The file itself must parse as JSON.
